pose.save.summary: Save a named product state as a local attribute manifest: identity/revision, joint values, parameter values, visibility, fill state, spring state, route variant and service/disconnection flags. Explicitly not a native ConfigurationTable.

inputs.name: Required nonempty pose name.
inputs.revision: Optional positive integer, default 1; bumped automatically on update.
inputs.joints: Optional array of {joint, rotation?|slide?} value expressions.
inputs.fillState: Optional FULL or EMPTY; the liquid-mass effect is resolved by GM23, not recomputed here.
inputs.springState: Optional FREE, COCKED or COMPRESSED; the force effect is resolved by GM12.
inputs.onExisting: error (default) or update; update requires confirm.

limitations: Local attribute manifest, not a native Fusion ConfigurationTable.

pose.apply.summary: Apply a saved pose and leave the requested state in place: drives joints (joint.drive), applies parameters (param.apply) and visibility; fill/spring/route/service states are manifest-carried.
limitations: apply leaves the requested state; there is no automatic restoration. Incompatible documents and stale refs are rejected before mutation.

pose.list.summary: List saved poses with name, revision, savedAt and document identity.
limitations: Read-only enumeration of the local manifest index.

pose.delete.summary: Delete a saved pose from the local manifest.
limitations: Deletes only the manifest record; no geometry is touched.

pose.evaluate.summary: Apply a pose temporarily and restore the previous state, reporting before/after/restoration; restoration failure is a separate error.
limitations: evaluate applies temporarily and restores; restoration failure is reported separately and does not guarantee the previous state was re-established.
